# Accepted claims

### claim-claim-manifest-delegation
- basis: observed

ManifestImportService maps each parsed ManifestLine to CreateDeliveryCommand and delegates it to DeliveryApplicationService.accept, returning the resulting receipt list.

Evidence:
- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/application/ManifestImportService.java:1-26

### claim-claim-manifest-input
- basis: observed

CsvManifestReader skips empty lines and a case-insensitive trackingId header, requires five columns, trims fields, and converts the locker-size column with LockerSize.valueOf.

Evidence:
- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/adapter/CsvManifestReader.java:1-43

### claim-claim-synthetic-boundary
- basis: supported-inference

Because Main composes only in-memory repositories and README says the executable fixture uses in-memory adapters, assignments are expected to be lost when the process exits; the source does not establish durable or concurrent persistence.

Evidence:
- file: src/com/blueprint/fixture/lockers/Main.java:1-49
- file: README.md
